verdict.rationale: Marqeta explicitly documents an 'Agentic AI MCP Server' for use with AI agents, naming virtual card issuance and spend controls (velocity limits, spending caps, merchant restrictions) as core capabilities, backed by underlying Core API primitives for velocity controls and merchant-locked authorization controls. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of an agent actually being issued a scoped card via MCP, and explicit documentation of expiry as an agent-specific control (only implied via general card/velocity controls).
